periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented upwards and outwards toward the ears.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Pronounced oval profile with a vertical-to-horizontal length ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, with the patch extending well below the eye's horizontal midline toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior edge of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 50% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation distance approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded curvature across the top boundary of both ears.
